name: site-audit
description: Pre-launch and regression quality audit of a website (Next.js-first, works on any URL): SEO, performance and Core Web Vitals, accessibility, responsiveness, semantic HTML, fonts, images, third-party scripts and consent. Audits one sample of every page type, runs a code scan, HTTP checks, a headless multi-page DOM audit and median-of-3 Lighthouse in one command, and keeps a tracked was→now checklist in your repo.
